definitions.explanation: The general level of prices of goods and services in an economy.

examples.japanese: {物価|ぶっか}が{上|あ}がっている。
{日本|にほん}は{物価|ぶっか}が{高|たか}い。
{物価|ぶっか}{上昇|じょうしょう}が{家計|かけい}を{圧迫|あっぱく}している。
examples.english: Rising prices are putting pressure on household budgets.
examples.notes: 物価上昇 = price increase, inflation

notes:
USAGE: {物価|ぶっか} refers to the general price level of goods and services, often discussed in economic contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{物価|ぶっか}が{上|あ}がる/{下|さ}がる (prices rise/fall)
・{物価|ぶっか}が{高|たか}い/{安|やす}い (prices are high/low)
・{物価|ぶっか}{上昇|じょうしょう} (price increase)
・{物価|ぶっか}{指数|しすう} (price index)
・{物価|ぶっか}{安定|あんてい} (price stability)

RELATED:
・{インフレ} - inflation
・{デフレ} - deflation
